name: bwlimit
help: Sets the bandwidth limit per player, in bytes a second. Not saved.

name: interp
help: Sets the interpolation delay, in seconds. Not saved.

name: mr
help: Sets the move rate (at most the tick rate). Not saved.

name: net_interpstats
help: How interpolation and movement handle each connection. Beta engine.

name: perfmon
help: The server performance score and its parts. Beta engine.

name: sendrate
help: Sets how many updates a second are sent to each client. Not saved.

name: sh_addroundlimit
help: Adds the given number of rounds to the round limit.

name: sh_addtimelimit
help: Adds the given time to the current map's time limit.

name: sh_afk_status
help: Displays information about the given player or all player's AFK state.

name: sh_alltalk
help: Enables or disables global all talk.

name: sh_alltalklocal
help: Enables or disables local all talk.

name: sh_alltalkpregame
help: Enables or disables all talk in the pregame.

name: sh_autobalance
help: Enables or disables auto balance. Player amount and seconds are optional.

name: sh_ban
help: Bans the given player for the given time in minutes. 0 is a permanent ban.

name: sh_banid
help: Bans the given Steam ID for the given time in minutes. 0 is a permanent ban.

name: sh_bwlimit
help: Sets the bandwidth limit per player and saves it.

name: sh_changelevel
help: Changes the map to the given level immediately.

name: sh_cheats
help: Enables or disables cheats mode.

name: sh_csay
help: Displays a message in the centre of all player's screens.

name: sh_customvote
help: Starts a vote with the given question.

name: sh_cyclemap
help: Cycles the map to the next one in the map cycle.

name: sh_darwin
help: Enables or disables Darwin mode on the given players (unlimited health and ammo).

name: sh_eject
help: Ejects the given commander.

name: sh_enablerandom
help: Enables (and applies) or disables forcing shuffled teams.

name: sh_forcebansync
help: Forces the bans plugin to reload ban data from the web.

name: sh_forcemapvote
help: Forces a map vote to start, if possible.

name: sh_forcerandom
help: Forces the given player(s) onto a random team.

name: sh_forceroundstart
help: Forces the round to start.

name: sh_friendlyfire
help: Sets the friendly fire scale. Use 0 to disable friendly fire.

name: sh_gag
help: Silences the given player's chat. If no duration is given, it will hold for the remainder of the map.

name: sh_gagid
help: Silences the given Steam ID's chat permanently until ungagged, persisting between map changes.

name: sh_help
help: View help info for available commands (omit <search text> to see all).

name: sh_hiveteams
help: Runs NS2's Hive skill team shuffler.

name: sh_interp
help: Sets the interpolation time and saves it.

name: sh_kick
help: Kicks the given player.

name: sh_listbans
help: Lists all stored bans from Shine.

name: sh_listgags
help: Lists all gagged players to the console.

name: sh_listmaps
help: Lists all installed maps on the server.

name: sh_listplugins
help: Lists all loaded plugins.

name: sh_listservers
help: Lists all registered servers that you can connect to.

name: sh_loadplugin
help: Loads or reloads a plugin.

name: sh_luarun
help: Runs a string of Lua code on the server. Be careful with this.

name: sh_moverate
help: Sets the move rate and saves it.

name: sh_nextmap
help: Displays the next map in the cycle or the next map voted for.

name: sh_password
help: Sets the server password. Leave password empty to reset.

name: sh_pm
help: Sends a private message to the given player.

name: sh_rcon
help: Executes a command on the server console.

name: sh_reloadmap
help: Reloads the current map.

name: sh_reloadusers
help: Reloads the user data, either from the web or locally depending on your config settings.

name: sh_rename
help: Renames the given player.

name: sh_renameid
help: Forces the player with the given Steam ID to always be named the given name.

name: sh_reset
help: Resets the game round.

name: sh_resumeplugin
help: Resumes a plugin.

name: sh_rr
help: Sends the given player(s) to the ready room.

name: sh_say
help: Sends a message to everyone.

name: sh_sendrate
help: Sets the rate of updates sent to clients and saves it.

name: sh_sendto
help: Moves the given player to the given target player.

name: sh_sendto_location
help: Moves the given player to the given location name.

name: sh_setresslots
help: Sets the number of reserved slots.

name: sh_setroundlimit
help: Sets the round limit.

name: sh_setteam
help: Sets the given player(s) onto the given team.

name: sh_setteamnames
help: Sets the names of the marine and alien teams.

name: sh_setteamscores
help: Sets the score for the marine and alien teams.

name: sh_settimelimit
help: Sets the current map's time limit.

name: sh_showmotd
help: Shows the message of the day to the given player.

name: sh_slay
help: Slays the given player(s).

name: sh_slotsummary
help: Displays a summary of player/spectator/reserved slot usage.

name: sh_status
help: Prints a list of all connected players and their relevant information.

name: sh_stopvote
help: Stops the current vanilla vote.

name: sh_suspendplugin
help: Suspends a plugin.

name: sh_teamsay
help: Sends a message to everyone on the given team.

name: sh_teamstats
help: View Hive skill based team statistics.

name: sh_tickrate
help: Sets the max server tickrate and saves it.

name: sh_timeleft
help: Displays the remaining time for the current map.

name: sh_unban
help: Unbans the given Steam ID.

name: sh_ungag
help: Stops silencing the given player's chat.

name: sh_ungagid
help: Stops silencing the given Steam ID's chat if they have been gagged with sh_gagid.

name: sh_unloadplugin
help: Unloads a plugin.

name: sh_unrenameid
help: Resets any forced name for the given Steam ID.

name: sh_veto
help: Cancels a map change from a successful map vote.

name: sh_who
help: Displays rank information about the given player, or all players.

name: sv_add_reserved_slot
help: Adds a new reserved slot for the SteamID specified.

name: sv_alltalk
help: Toggles alltalk and changes the server setting

name: sv_auto_kick_afk
help: Auto-kick is disabled when the first argument is 0. A player will be kicked only when the server is at the defined capacity (0-1).

name: sv_autobalance
help: Toggles auto team balance. The player count and seconds are optional. Count defaults to 2 over balance to enable. Defaults to 10 second wait to enable.

name: sv_ban
help: Bans the player from the server, pass in 0 for duration to ban forever

name: sv_changemap
help: Switches to the map specified

name: sv_cheats
help: Turns cheats on and off

name: sv_defercreations
help: Let new objects arrive a few updates later under bwlimit. Beta engine.

name: sv_dyndns
help: Set a dynamic dns for the server. Use "" to disable the usage of the dyndns.

name: sv_eject
help: Ejects Commander from the Command Structure

name: sv_endgamehive2
help: Ends the game round

name: sv_forceeventeams
help: Balances teams based on previous round and Hive skill

name: sv_hitreglog
help: Log every hit scored during a rewound shot. Beta engine.

name: sv_installmod
help: downloads the given mod to the server

name: sv_interpadapt
help: Per-player interpolation delay; 0 puts everyone on interp. Beta engine.

name: sv_kick
help: Kicks the player from the server

name: sv_lagcompkeepclean
help: Skip re-posing what a rewind did not change. Beta engine.

name: sv_lagcomplazy
help: Rewind only when a move needs a collision check. Beta engine.

name: sv_listbans
help: Lists the banned players

name: sv_maxbots
help: The server will add the max amount of bots dynamically to the teams

name: sv_maxrewind
help: The longest lag-compensation rewind. Beta engine.

name: sv_maxtimecredit
help: How much queued movement replays at once; 0 is the old behaviour. Beta engine.

name: sv_movetimeslack
help: Movement timing check; 0 restores the old behaviour. Beta engine.

name: sv_p_endlog
help: Ends performance logging

name: sv_p_logall
help: Starts performance logging

name: sv_password
help: Changes the password on the server

name: sv_pregamealltalk
help: Toggles pregamealltalk and changes the server setting

name: sv_psay
help: Sends a message to a single player

name: sv_randomall
help: Forces all players to join a random team

name: sv_rateadapt
help: Lower a player's update rate when bwlimit chokes it. Beta engine.

name: sv_remove_reserved_slot
help: Removes the reserved slot for the SteamID specified.

name: sv_reserved_slots
help: Set the amount of reserved slots available on the server.

name: sv_reset
help: Resets the game round

name: sv_rookieonly
help: Toggles rookie_only and changes the server setting

name: sv_rrall
help: Forces all players to go to the Ready Room

name: sv_say
help: Sends a message to every player on the server

name: sv_setseason
help: Sets what season is loaded. Requires map change

name: sv_setseasonmonth
help: Overrides the month used for the ByDate season

name: sv_slay
help: Kills player

name: sv_spawnteams
help: marinespawnname, alienspawnname, Spawns teams at specified locations. Locations must be exact

name: sv_status
help: Lists player Ids and names for use in sv commands

name: sv_statusip
help: Lists player Ids and names for use in sv commands

name: sv_switchteam
help: 0 is Ready Room, 1 is Marines, 2 is Aliens, 3 is Spectate

name: sv_tests
help: Turns tests mode on and off. Grants access to commands such as nav_debug, and collision.

name: sv_tournament
help: Enables or disabled tournament mode.

name: sv_tsay
help: Sends a message to one team

name: sv_unban
help: Removes the player matching the passed in Steam Id from the ban list

name: tickrate
help: Sets the server tick rate. Not saved; Shine's sh_tickrate saves it.

name: tickstat
help: Logs tick-rate stability every N seconds; 0 turns it off. Beta engine.
